description.value: Breakers Pub is a locally owned waterfront pub in Prince Rupert's Cow Bay neighborhood, perched over the water between the Prince Rupert Yacht Club and Atlin Terminal with direct views of the working harbour. In operation since 1986, it is considered a North Coast landmark and draws both locals and visitors to its 46-seat summer patio where seals, otters, and eagles are regularly spotted. The pub is 19+ and sits within walking distance of the cruise ship docks in one of Prince Rupert's busiest tourist areas.
